title: SYSTEM LABELS IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, with Waypoint as the one marker word (his Marked Waypoint) and up top, never the map, as the place. The system lines were sentences: Zoom 115%, HUD size 100%, Waypoint marked, Marker placed. Your party can see it., Controller connected. Left stick moves, right stick aims., Cursor reset., the recorder lines and the loaner reminder. They now read ZOOM 115%, HUD SIZE 100%, WAYPOINT SET (with Your party can see it. in a party), WAYPOINT CLEARED, CONTROLLER CONNECTED, CONTROLLER DISCONNECTED with Plug it in, then resume., CURSOR RESET, RECORDING with [F9] stops it, or it stops at 3:00., RECORDING KEPT, SUPERHOT FOLLOWS THE HOST and YOU CARRY A LOANER with Equip your own gun at The Stash. The blackout detail reads Every lamp up top is dead. The Undercroft lines are unchanged.
now: Zoom, HUD size, Waypoint, controller, cursor, recorder and loaner lines read as caps system labels, and Waypoint is the one marker word.
